verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ אֶל־ שֹׁשַׁנִּ֑ים עֵד֖וּת לְאָסָ֣ף מִזְמֽוֹר׃ רֹ֘עֵ֤ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֨ל׀ הַאֲזִ֗ינָה נֹהֵ֣ג כַּצֹּ֣אן יוֹסֵ֑ף יֹשֵׁ֖ב הַכְּרוּבִ֣ים הוֹפִֽיעָה׃
verses.transliteration: lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ ’el- šō·šan·nîm ‘ê·ḏūṯ lə·’ā·sāp̄ miz·mō·wr rō·‘êh yiś·rā·’êl ha·’ă·zî·nāh nō·hêḡ kaṣ·ṣōn yō·w·sêp̄ yō·šêḇ hak·kə·rū·ḇîm hō·w·p̄î·‘āh
verses.literal: For the choirmaster To the tune of The Lilies of the Covenant A Psalm of Asaph Hear us O Shepherd of Israel who leads Joseph like a flock You who sit enthroned between the cherubim shine forth
verses.literalPt: Escuta, ó pastor de Israel; tu que conduzes a José como a um rebanho, que estás entronizado sobre os querubins, resplandece.

verses.original: לִפְנֵ֤י אֶפְרַ֨יִם׀ וּבִנְיָ֘מִ֤ן וּמְנַשֶּׁ֗ה עוֹרְרָ֥ה אֶת־ גְּבֽוּרָתֶ֑ךָ וּלְכָ֖ה לִישֻׁעָ֣תָה לָּֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: lip̄·nê ’ep̄·ra·yim ū·ḇin·yā·min ū·mə·naš·šeh ‘ō·wr·rāh ’eṯ- gə·ḇū·rā·ṯe·ḵā ū·lə·ḵāh lî·šu·‘ā·ṯāh lā·nū
verses.literal: before Ephraim Benjamin and Manasseh Rally Your mighty power and come to save us
verses.literalPt: Diante de Efraim, de Benjamim e de Manassés, desperta o teu poder e vem salvar-nos.

verses.literal: Restore us O God and cause Your face to shine upon us that we may be saved
verses.literalPt: Converte-nos, ó Deus; faze resplandecer o teu rosto, e seremos salvos.

verses.original: יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֣ים צְבָא֑וֹת עַד־ מָתַ֥י עָ֝שַׁ֗נְתָּ בִּתְפִלַּ֥ת עַמֶּֽךָ׃
verses.literal: O LORD God of Hosts how long . . . will Your anger smolder against the prayers of Your people
verses.literalPt: Jeová, Deus dos Exércitos, até quando te mostrarás indignado contra a oração do teu povo?

verses.original: הֶ֭אֱכַלְתָּם לֶ֣חֶם דִּמְעָ֑ה וַ֝תַּשְׁקֵ֗מוֹ בִּדְמָע֥וֹת שָׁלִֽישׁ׃
verses.transliteration: he·’ĕ·ḵal·tām le·ḥem dim·‘āh wat·taš·qê·mōw biḏ·mā·‘ō·wṯ šā·lîš
verses.literal: You fed them with the bread of tears and made them drink the full measure of their tears
verses.literalPt: Tu os fizeste comer pão de lágrimas e lhes deste a beber lágrimas em abundância.

verses.original: תְּשִׂימֵ֣נוּ מָ֭דוֹן לִשְׁכֵנֵ֑ינוּ וְ֝אֹיְבֵ֗ינוּ יִלְעֲגוּ־ לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: tə·śî·mê·nū mā·ḏō·wn liš·ḵê·nê·nū wə·’ō·yə·ḇê·nū yil·‘ă·ḡū- lā·mōw
verses.literal: You make us contend with our neighbors our enemies mock us
verses.literalPt: Fazes-nos servir de contendas aos nossos vizinhos, e os nossos inimigos riem-se à vontade.

verses.original: אֱלֹהִ֣ים צְבָא֣וֹת הֲשִׁיבֵ֑נוּ וְהָאֵ֥ר פָּ֝נֶ֗יךָ וְנִוָּשֵֽׁעָה׃
verses.literal: Restore us O God of Hosts and cause Your face to shine upon us that we may be saved
verses.literalPt: Converte-nos, Deus dos Exércitos; faze resplandecer o teu rosto, e seremos salvos.

verses.original: גֶּ֭פֶן מִמִּצְרַ֣יִם תַּסִּ֑יעַ תְּגָרֵ֥שׁ גּ֝וֹיִ֗ם וַתִּטָּעֶֽהָ׃
verses.transliteration: ge·p̄en mim·miṣ·ra·yim tas·sî·a‘ tə·ḡā·rêš gō·w·yim wat·tiṭ·ṭā·‘e·hā
verses.literal: You uprooted a vine from Egypt You drove out the nations and transplanted it
verses.literalPt: Trouxeste do Egito uma videira; expeliste as nações e a plantaste.

verses.original: פִּנִּ֥יתָ לְפָנֶ֑יהָ וַתַּשְׁרֵ֥שׁ שָׁ֝רָשֶׁ֗יהָ וַתְּמַלֵּא־ אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.literal: You cleared the ground for it and it took root and filled the land
verses.literalPt: Dispuseste o terreno diante dela; ela deitou profundas raízes e encheu a terra.

verses.original: כָּסּ֣וּ הָרִ֣ים צִלָּ֑הּ וַ֝עֲנָפֶ֗יהָ אַֽרְזֵי־ אֵֽל׃
verses.literal: The mountains were covered by its shade and the mighty cedars with its branches
verses.literalPt: Cobriram-se os montes com a sombra dela, e, com os seus sarmentos, os cedros de Deus.

verses.original: תְּשַׁלַּ֣ח קְצִירֶ֣הָ עַד־ יָ֑ם וְאֶל־ נָ֝הָ֗ר יֽוֹנְקוֹתֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: tə·šal·laḥ qə·ṣî·re·hā ‘aḏ- yām wə·’el- nā·hār yō·wn·qō·w·ṯe·hā
verses.literal: It sent out its branches to the Sea and its shoots toward the River
verses.literalPt: Ela estendeu os seus ramos até o mar e os seus rebentos, até o rio.

verses.original: לָ֭מָּה פָּרַ֣צְתָּ גְדֵרֶ֑יהָ וְ֝אָר֗וּהָ כָּל־ עֹ֥בְרֵי דָֽרֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: lām·māh pā·raṣ·tā ḡə·ḏê·re·hā wə·’ā·rū·hā kāl- ‘ō·ḇə·rê ḏā·reḵ
verses.literal: Why have You broken down its walls so that all who pass by . . . pick its fruit
verses.literalPt: Por que lhe derrubaste as cercas, de sorte que a vindimam todos os que passam pelo caminho?

verses.original: יְכַרְסְמֶ֣נָּֽה חֲזִ֣יר מִיָּ֑עַר וְזִ֖יז שָׂדַ֣י יִרְעֶֽנָּה׃
verses.transliteration: yə·ḵar·sə·men·nāh ḥă·zîr mī·yå̄·ʿar wə·zîz śā·ḏay yir·‘en·nāh
verses.literal: The boar from the forest ravages it and the creatures of the field feed upon it
verses.literalPt: O javali da selva a devasta, e os animais do campo dela se nutrem.

verses.original: אֱלֹהִ֣ים צְבָאוֹת֮ שֽׁ֫וּב־ נָ֥א הַבֵּ֣ט מִשָּׁמַ֣יִם וּרְאֵ֑ה וּ֝פְקֹ֗ד גֶּ֣פֶן זֹֽאת׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·lō·hîm ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ šūḇ- nā hab·bêṭ miš·šā·ma·yim ū·rə·’êh ū·p̄ə·qōḏ ge·p̄en zōṯ
verses.literal: Return O God of Hosts we pray Look down from heaven and see Attend to this vine
verses.literalPt: Volta, te rogamos, ó Deus dos Exércitos; olha lá do céu, e vê, e visita esta videira;

verses.original: וְ֭כַנָּה אֲשֶׁר־ נָטְעָ֣ה יְמִינֶ֑ךָ וְעַל־ בֵּ֝֗ן אִמַּ֥צְתָּה לָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵan·nāh ’ă·šer- nā·ṭə·‘āh yə·mî·ne·ḵā wə·‘al- bên ’im·maṣ·tāh lāḵ
verses.literal: the root Your right hand . . . has planted the son You have raised up for Yourself
verses.literalPt: protege o que a tua mão direita plantou, o bacelo que para ti robusteceste.

verses.original: שְׂרֻפָ֣ה בָאֵ֣שׁ כְּסוּחָ֑ה מִגַּעֲרַ֖ת פָּנֶ֣יךָ יֹאבֵֽדוּ׃
verses.transliteration: śə·ru·p̄āh ḇā·’êš kə·sū·ḥāh mig·ga·‘ă·raṯ pā·ne·ḵā yō·ḇê·ḏū
verses.literal: Your vine has been cut down and burned . . . they perish at the rebuke of Your countenance
verses.literalPt: Está queimada de fogo, está decepada; eles perecem pelas repreensões do teu rosto.

verses.original: תְּֽהִי־ יָ֭דְךָ עַל־ אִ֣ישׁ יְמִינֶ֑ךָ עַל־ בֶּן־ אָ֝דָ֗ם אִמַּ֥צְתָּ לָּֽךְ׃
verses.literal: Let Your hand be upon the man at Your right hand on the son of man You have raised up for Yourself
verses.literalPt: Seja o teu rosto sobre o varão da tua destra, sobre o filho do homem que para ti robusteceste.

verses.original: וְלֹא־ נָס֥וֹג מִמֶּ֑ךָּ תְּ֝חַיֵּ֗נוּ וּבְשִׁמְךָ֥ נִקְרָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- nā·sō·wḡ mim·me·kā tə·ḥay·yê·nū ū·ḇə·šim·ḵā niq·rā
verses.literal: Then we will not turn away from You revive us and we will call on Your name
verses.literalPt: Assim, não nos apartaremos de ti; vivifica-nos, e nós invocaremos o teu nome.

verses.original: יְה֘וָ֤ה אֱלֹהִ֣ים צְבָא֣וֹת הֲשִׁיבֵ֑נוּ הָאֵ֥ר פָּ֝נֶ֗יךָ וְנִוָּשֵֽׁעָה׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hîm ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ hă·šî·ḇê·nū hā·’êr pā·ne·ḵā wə·niw·wā·šê·‘āh
verses.literal: Restore us O LORD God of Hosts cause Your face to shine upon us that we may be saved
verses.literalPt: Converte-nos, Jeová, Deus dos Exércitos; faze resplandecer o teu rosto, e seremos salvos.
